headline: Frontline Flare as Bases Swap Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the churn has widened across the map. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s bloodiest sector, its 24‑hour toll now 169,399 Colonial and 186,383 Warden dead with eleven ownership changes; both casualty streams and enlistments are still accelerating. Linn Mercy continues to drive the heaviest fighting around Rotdust and Lathair, logging twenty‑two flips, 54,065 Colonial and 67,923 Warden casualties, and a sharp rise in recruitment. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to eighteen flips, Colonial losses at 51,047 and Warden at 64,284, with casualties and sign‑ups both accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports seven flips, casualties climbing to 54,827 Colonial and 60,902 Warden, while loss rates cool. Fresh turnover appears on Farranac Coast (five flips, mixed 2‑Warden/9‑Colonial control), Fishermans Row (four flips, Fort Ember most active), and Gutter (five flips, The Parras busy). Deadlands adds no new flips and its casualty rates are cooling. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors still show no ownership changes.
